headline: Puro.earth issues 280,000 CORCs to a Nebraska corn-ethanol BECCS project
summary: Carbon-removal registry Puro.earth issued ~280,000 CO2 Removal Certificates to a BECCS project tied to ADM's Columbus, Nebraska ethanol complex, with biogenic CO2 stored via the Tallgrass Trailblazer pipeline — converting ADM's September market-entry plan into delivered, verified geologic-storage credits.
co2crc_note: Verified geologic-storage-backed BECCS crediting at scale is a precedent for the removal-credit integrity and MMV frameworks underpinning CO2CRC-linked research.
extractor_note: 280,000 is a CORC credit count (capacity_mtpa reflects credits issued, not annual capture capacity of 0.8+ Mtpa); not a money figure.

headline: QatarEnergy and Japan's JBIC sign energy MoU spanning LNG, CCS and power
summary: QatarEnergy and the Japan Bank for International Cooperation are reported to have signed an MoU on energy cooperation covering LNG, carbon capture and storage, and power, extending the Gulf NOC/Japanese policy-bank financing relationship into carbon management. Single-source, not independently corroborated this session.
co2crc_note: A Gulf NOC paired with Japanese policy-bank finance on CCS mirrors the Australia-Japan/Asia value-chain and project-finance structures relevant to Australian CCS exports.
extractor_note: Single trade-press source; WebFetch verification blocked this session — scope preliminary.

headline: Carbon Pulse: COPs face a 'technology neutrality' problem after the CCUS fight in Antalya
summary: A Carbon Pulse briefing analyses the carbon-capture dispute that helped sink COP31's cover decision, arguing the failure to set the first quantified CCUS/CDR capacity goals has left the UN process split over whether CCS and removals belong in headline targets or are a fossil-aligned distraction.
co2crc_note: Shapes the post-COP31 international policy and social-licence environment in which Australian CCS projects seek legitimacy and finance.
